events.title: The Choir of Man
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Olivier Award-nominated, West End acclaimed, and globally adored, hundreds of thousands of fans across four continents can't be wrong. This is the show the whole world has been raising a glass to. Stunning harmonies and foot-stomping singalongs, brimming with hits, all with a real bar on stage. A wildly talented cast of nine (extra)ordinary guys, world-class tap dancers, slam poets, multi-instrumentalists and powerhouse singers, serve it all live.

events.title: Sunrise Ceremony: Bikki Wantimaa
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Each Friday morning the Sunrise Ceremony: Bikki Wantimaa acknowledges and gives thanks to the lands on which the Festival takes place, honouring First Nations peoples who have witnessed the sunrise on these lands for thousands of years.

events.title: The Knock ‘Em Downs
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Step inside the colourful carnival tent, where nostalgia has taken a curious twist, and the carnies have turned into clowns! Take a trip back in time to the side shows of old - a strange and bewildering world featuring a variety of side show games sure to test your skill, with big prizes to be won. This off-beat encounter will tickle your ribs and wobble your funny bone!

events.title: Piano Man

events.title: Family Fun Day supported by Brisbane Airport
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Pack your sunscreen, grab the kids and glide onto the Village Green in Verso Projects. Festival Village, South Bank for a first-class day of free family-friendly performances, entertainment and activities.

events.title: Pasifika Made
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Pasifika Made returns to Brisbane Festival in 2026, bringing together Pacific and First Nations artists, cultural practitioners and community across a program of cultural and contemporary live performance, workshops, artist talks, knowledge sharing, live demonstrations and a cultural marketplace experience. Transforming Festival Village into a gathering place for art, culture and connection, Pasifika Made presents Pacific arts through both ancestral practice and a contemporary lens.

events.title: This Show is a Joke!
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Hold onto your cowpats! After nearly two decades of seriously silly nonsense, Matt and Rich (aka The Listies) have whipped up their most ridiculous show yet — a turbo-charged mash-up of fan favourites, slapstick, songs, and a fresh batch of brand-new, freshly hatched gags. It's a comedy extravaganza for kidults aged 4 to 4 million (dinosaurs welcome).

events.title: Strong is the New Pretty
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: Suzie Miller, the celebrated Australian playwright behind sell-out smash hit RBG: Of Many, One and international phenomenon Prima Facie, turns her extraordinary talents to the historical formation of the AFLW in this world premiere.

events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank

events.title: The Book of Mormon The Musical
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: The New York Times calls it “the best musical of this century”. The Washington Post says, “it is the kind of evening that restores your faith in musicals”. And Entertainment Weekly says, “grade A: the funniest musical of all time”. It’s THE BOOK OF MORMON , the nine-time Tony Award®-winning Best Musical.

events.title: Betsy Balloon and the Very Great Terrible Flood
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: A rambunctious modern fable. Welcome to the island of Helium where Betsy lives with her balloon-factory-owning family. They're cheerful, a bit money-mad and life is on the up. But when the world turns against balloons, their world pops and Betsy must start a new life in a faraway city with her eccentric uncle, Hercules Snark, an inventor of mostly half-finished things. Unfortunately, Snark has problems of his own. In his city, it never stops raining. The streets are flooding. And things, quite literally, are starting to sink. Betsy Balloon is a rambunctious modern fable presented with original music and illustration based on a story by Bill Manhire. Betsy Balloon and the Very Great Terrible Flood is part of Brisbane Festival.

events.title: ESCAPE
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: A boundary-breaking fusion of human movement and physical structures. DIAVOLO | Architecture in Motion® productions explore innovation and celebrate the complexity of the human condition with an undefinable blend of dance, stunt work, acrobatics, circus arts, and pedestrian movement. The work is athletic, captivating, and visceral. This is a show that will leave you breathless. Visceral and high-octane, ESCAPE blends complex, moving architectural structures with multi-talented performers to create a blood-pumping and emotional multimedia experience. Along with DIAVOLO's signature athletic movement aesthetic, ESCAPE features a collection of the company's most famous architectural structures. Each evokes a story unique to its design, echoing themes of exploration, danger, fear, survival, resilience, and connection, all brought to life through a soundtrack spanning decades and genres, from pop and EDM to rock.

events.title: Piano Man: Celebrating the Music of Billy Joel
events.location: South Bank Parklands, Grey St, South Bank
events.description: For more than 50 years, American singer, songwriter and pianist Billy Joel has made an indelible mark on the American songbook. With 33 top 40 hits, 5 Grammy Awards and over 160 million albums worldwide, he is one of the most successful artists of all time. This September at the Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre, QSO under the baton of Jessica Gethin will celebrate Billy Joel in Piano Man. Directed by Mark Sutcliffe and starring Phil Burton, Alinta Chidzey, Jess Hitchcock and Josh Piterman, Piano Man features new orchestral arrangements by Nicholas Buc covering his greatest hits including Just the Way You Are, She's Always a Woman, New York State of Mind, Only the Good Die Young, Vienna and of course Piano Man. Featuring: Mark Sutcliffe director Nicholas Buc arranger Phil Burton vocalist Alinta Chidzey vocalist Jess Hitchcock vocalist Josh Piterman vocalist *Please note: This concert does not feature Billy Joel in person. Piano Man is presented in association with Make My Mark.
